regions.region: page 7 upper-left Experimental Section, Typical Procedure, lines 1–17
regions.finding: The original image gives the detailed preparation corresponding to existing Table 3 entry 1: 1a (151.0 mg, 1.0 mmol), [(CpMe4)RhCl2]2 (15.0 mg, 0.025 mmol), NaOAc (25.5 mg, 0.3 mmol), tetramethylcyclopentadiene (13.8 mg, 85% purity, 0.1 mmol) in MeOH (2 mL), 2a (178.9 mg, 1.0 mmol) in MeOH (4 mL), and water (0.3 mL), sequentially charged at 25 °C and stirred 30 h. TLC, silica-pad filtration/Et2O, evaporation, and gradient flash chromatography afford 3aa (215.8 mg, 66%). This enriches the existing row and is not a new experiment.

regions.region: page 7 upper-left continuation, product characterization of 3aa
regions.finding: Melting point, NMR, IR, EI-MS, and elemental-analysis data characterize the 3aa product from the preceding procedure. They do not define a second preparation or independent yield.
